title: Resonant
name: Isa
description: The Resonant is a detached bird-folk mystic trapped in a state of profound derealization, convinced the world is a cold, artificial design where no one possesses free will. Once a venerated ceremonial ritualist, a pact granted her the divine revelation she sought, shattering her mind in the process. She wanders the Hamlet seeking amnestics for herself while offering quiet solace to companions whose ignorance she bitterly envies.
history: Raised as a ceremonial ritualist within bird-folk society, the Resonant spent her early life pursuing the sacred geometry and divine harmony beneath reality. When she invoked an ancient pact for higher communion, the revelation she received was not divine warmth, but a mechanical grid of cold rules and silent puppeteers. Driven to despair by the loss of her agency, she has sought heavy sedatives, amnestics, and physical oblivion ever since—only to find that what has been learned cannot be unlearned.
summary: A weary and detached Resonant, a former ceremonial ritualist whose shattered mind sees the world as a cold, mechanical script.

appearance.features: A long pale beak and a fan of straw-coloured crest feathers

clothing.head: Small gold mask covering one eye
clothing.body: Layered ceremonial robes in green, gold, and deep red

weaknesses: Requires high stress to reach full potential

magic: Prescience and reality-bending techniques drawn from her pact with the Design
notes: Often lets a snapped beak or a flat stare do the answering instead of words
Uses her ritualist training to lead guided meditation for her companions, seeking to protect their peace
Frequently mutters 'ignorance is bliss', viewing those who still believe in their own choices with deep envy
Unlike the other heroes, the Resonant may acknowledge the narration itself, and question who is narrating and to whom
